why: Mail scan, Tuesday 15:00 Jakarta: INSEAD chasing the Business Foundations payment

notes.itemTitle: Decide on Business Foundations and register
notes.title: Pay Business Foundations by Friday
notes.text: INSEAD says your 1,530 euros has not arrived and wants it by Friday to hold your place. They also ask you to reply to Celine Chin's reminder with the payment proof attached, which is the part most people miss. - The bank details are in that email.
